action_rules: Exact keys; no extra grant/auth/sent fields.
Action identifier is server-owned and <=128 characters, never generated from an untrusted body.
Payload recipient_ref is a trusted server lookup reference; it is not a recipient address asserted by the model.

kind SEND|REPLY|FOLLOWUP|HANDOFF; SEND/REPLY/FOLLOWUP payload exact recipient_ref,subject,body; HANDOFF exact recipient_ref,handoff_id,content_sha256,context. All action/scope/template/fact/version IDs<=128chars; scope.thread_id nullable only SEND.
Expected revision is exact int >=0, bool forbidden.
Policy version/locale/packversion and payload hash are immutable after journal create.
Same scoped action_id plus identical full canonical intent -> idempotent; changed intent -> conflict.
Canonical payload bytes: JSON ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators comma colon,allow_nan=False then UTF8.
All inputs independent deep copies. No clock/random/env/file/network side effects in pure components.

HANDOFF requires template_id=null; fact_ids are complete trusted context facts subset of approved campaign facts; handoff payload includes full accepted assembled context and recipient_ref, handoff_id,content_sha256. SEND/REPLY/FOLLOWUP require nonempty approved template_id; no fake handoff template is invented.

Initial SEND comes from trusted campaign/preparation adapter. Camel decision enum is NOOP|STOP|HANDOFF|PROPOSE_REPLY|PROPOSE_FOLLOWUP|QUARANTINE; integrator maps PROPOSE_REPLY to REPLY, PROPOSE_FOLLOWUP to FOLLOWUP, HANDOFF to HANDOFF. No fabricated INTRO enum.
policy_rules: Snapshot comes from server-owned authenticated repository/config, never inbound body or model JSON.
Reference strings and schema markers are not proof of authentication, owner approval or grant.
NO_OUTBOUND denies real external actions even when every other predicate succeeds.
Production future grant verification and revocation require a distinct trusted gateway and fresh transaction-side check.
Check expected revision, exact scope, status, ownership, opt-out, quota, budget and version before adapter call.
Avoid claiming atomic quotas/fencing from a pure decision; persistence transaction owns reservation/CAS.
campaign_status RUNNING|PAUSED|EXHAUSTED; dialogue ownership is separate AUTOMATION|HUMAN|STOPPED; stop control supplied separately as emergency_stop bool; no invented ACTIVE campaign status.

Pure decision ELIGIBLE|DENY; external_effect_authorized always false. Actual NO_OUTBOUND always denies even with otherwise valid grant. Synthetic CONTROLLED fixture plus typed trusted grant verifies future eligibility only, never creates permission.

limits.F102: body<=65536 UTF8 bytes; now/received_at aware; future<=300sec; opaque IDs have no frozen max
limits.F107: ID<=512 UTF8 bytes; email<=320 bytes; headers<=64 pairs and16384 cumulative bytes; rejects NUL/lone surrogate
limits.F111: new scope/recordID<=256chars; records<=1000; outbound_ids<=100; old eventIDs no new max
limits.F109: IDs<=128chars; history1..100; facts/materials0..50; preserve full history or reject

integration_boundary: Append original event before correlation; do not inject lead_id into FIRST_INBOUND_V1.
Unknown/human/stopped preserve inbox evidence; no action dispatch.
Provider authenticates outside normalizer; trust cannot be established by auth=true.
Duplicate inbox record may still have unprocessed dialogue work.
Pending F102/F103/F111 outputs can be represented by frozen fixtures in candidate tests, but assembled acceptance remains BLOCKED until exact accepted code is available.

transaction_fencing_protocol.rule: Use caller-owned transaction, SELECT matching lease row FOR UPDATE. Validate unexpired exact ownership/generation; no commit/rollback/connection close. Row lock held until protected write transaction completes. Raise STALE_OWNER on failure. Journal injects this frozen protocol; candidate tests self-contained fake and integration batch actual F116 implementation. Expiry compares PostgreSQL clock_timestamp(); caller now is never production expiry authority.

transaction_state_revision_protocol: assert_state_revision(conn,*,scope:dict,expected_revision:int)->None; lock actual authoritative conversation state row then compare exact revision; no commit/rollback/close
grant_rules: Exact keys matching literal fixture; scope exact shared scope; IDs<=128chars, canonical runtime UUID; versions nonempty IDs; grant_revision positive int bool forbidden.
valid_from/expires_at aware UTCISO; valid_from<=now<expires_at; revoked exact bool.
allowed_kinds unique list1..4 enumSEND|REPLY|FOLLOWUP|HANDOFF; allowed_recipient_refs unique list1..100 identifiers<=128chars.

Grant is an already authenticated/owner-approved repository projection injected by trusted server code. JSON shape/schema/approvalref alone cannot establish authority; never forward provider/model grant fields.

CONTROLLED is a separate future policy snapshot enum, never an F105 release_mode nor output of campaign projection. Current integration retains NO_OUTBOUND; synthetic CONTROLLED fixtures exercise pure predicate without any send or permission mutation.
Snapshot grant_ref/current_grant_revision must equal grant; scope and binding/policy versions exact; fresh revocation/revision checked again in atomic dispatch transaction by integration owner.

ScopeV1.thread_id_rule: null only SEND; nonnull for REPLY/FOLLOWUP/HANDOFF

gate_validation_precedence.condition: action/policy not exact dict; grant neither exact dict nor None; now not datetime; root args checked in action,policy,grant,now order
wrong schema marker/missing/extra keys or wrong nested scalar/list/object types; inspect action,policy,grant in that order; strict builtin types; integer bool rejected
invalid ID/UUID/hash/duplicate kind or fact IDs, in action then policy then grant order
now naive/no UTC offset; policy.valid_until or grant validity malformed/naive; grant valid_from >= expires_at
kind payload mismatch; HANDOFF template not null; mail template null; nonSEND thread null; payload hash does not match canonical bytes; HANDOFF crossscope/hash/locale/context/facts mismatch

gate_business_deny_precedence: SCOPE_MISMATCH: exact action.scope != policy.scope including nullable thread
GRANT_REQUIRED: CONTROLLED policy and grant None
GRANT_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: grant_ref does not equal policy.grant_ref, including null
GRANT_SCOPE_MISMATCH: grant.scope != action.scope; no wildcards and no null equivalence
GRANT_VERSION_MISMATCH: grant binding_version or policy_version mismatch
GRANT_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: selectedlocale absent or pack version differs
gate_action_semantics: SEND can have thread_id null or known ID. Other kinds require existing thread ID. Scope runtime_campaign_id is canonical UUID; lead_id is opaque ID, no invented UUID requirement.
SEND/REPLY/FOLLOWUP payload has exactly recipient_ref,subject,body; template_id nonnull. HANDOFF payload has exactly recipient_ref,handoff_id,content_sha256,context; template_id null.
Hash uses json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False).encode UTF8; no mutation; reject unencodable strings.

Payload recipient_ref is a trusted recipient lookup ref; mail recipient_ref should equal scope.lead_id in these bounded mail tasks. Handoff recipient_ref is authorized human route reference and cannot be replaced by buyer body data.

HANDOFF context scope equals action scope; event_id equals handoff_id and context.handoff_id; content hash equals context.content_sha256; fact_ids equal unique context.facts fact_ids and all approved campaign facts checked by producer; policy/language versions equal context.

No caller-supplied dict or schema marker proves semantic source authenticity. Typed verified snapshot is a boundary contract issued by trusted repository adapter; the pure function cannot authenticate it.
source_trust_and_live_boundary: F105 unchanged outputs NO_OUTBOUND. CONTROLLED is a NEW execution snapshot schema built only by the integrator from a separately verified server grant; never promote F105 output or use no_outbound=false.

Grant object comes from authenticated repository adapter that verifies owner authorization, exact scope, accepted binding/pack identities and revocation. Provider/model/body JSON is never accepted as a grant source.

ELIGIBLE means all supplied current predicates satisfied; external_effect_authorized is always false because actual dispatch still requires transaction-time fresh policy/grant/quota/state/fence checks and provider adapter integration.

Future real eligibility predicates are fully tested in this same component; no later large gate rewrite is required. Actual live permissions and side-effect executor are separate; this artifact grants none.
No execution_mode argument, ALLOW_SIMULATED or ALLOW_LIVE enum. Offline synthetic CONTROLLED positive vector checks eligibility without a network call.

adapter_payload_limit.reason: Explicit NEW adapter boundary, not inherited F109 limit. F109 language_packs cardinality is unbounded; cannot promise accepts every valid old context. Oversize rejects PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE without truncation; original accepted context retained by caller.
